Money: always approved, totals in code.
to prove it · keep N · copy
every write = fn in a txn
work jobs · steps · approvals · outbox · schedules
seq = rowid → strictly increasing in commit order
keeps argusd · worker · ari_listen · ari_popup alive · restarts on new code
step() · llm() · claude() · approve() · ask_me() · notify() · tool() · embed() · saved() · wait()
files: manifest folders ∩ paths.allowed, never paths.blocked · recycle only · no overwrite
http: manifest hosts · secrets: listed names · dry-run until live · every change = undo event
built-in: ari.think (agent loop ≤ 6) · guidance.review · ask · power · health · hear · backup copy · demo
Deploy: today everything runs on the PC (dev). Next: argusd moves to the laptop (Ubuntu, systemd, deploy/README.md); the PC stays the GPU worker, woken on demand.
Data never leaves the tailnet except: phone notifications (ntfy), Claude calls (capped, tools off), Ari's web search. Office (DirectFN) data is blocked for every plugin.
